coordinates: WGS84 [longitude, latitude]; null where source coverage or station location is unresolved.
policy: Proposed polling/cache numbers are design choices, not provider guarantees. No automatic requests are added by this registry.

sources.name: Local sun and moon

spatial.basis: Existing Aquarium campus anchor used as a query point, not a weather measurement station.

access.requirements: No recurring network required. Evaluate a pinned local algorithm/library and retain its license; none was installed.
access.rights: SunCalc is a candidate reference with BSD-2-Clause licensing; retain notices if chosen.

refreshProposal.proposal: Compute on scene/time/location change; recalculate at a low rate while active and interpolate lighting. Display in America/Los_Angeles, store UTC.

possibleGameUses: Shared local day/night, sunset sky colors, sun shadows and moonlit water
limitations: Computed ephemeris is not observed cloud cover or fog. Retain an explicit inspection/demo clock override.

mapStudy.method: Independent implementation of NOAA fractional-year equations; computed on snapshot reads, no polling or SunCalc dependency.
limitations: Approximation excludes cloud, fog and local terrain.
Moon, twilight and sun-direction integration remain unimplemented.

sources.name: Monterey observed water level
signals: water level metres relative to MLLW

spatial.basis: NOAA CO-OPS metadata for station 9413450, checked 2026-10-20. Measurement support is a station, not a bay-wide elevation survey.

access.requirements: No key used for probe. Respect rate limits, preserve flags and keep datum/units/time zone explicit.
access.rights: Public NOAA service; retain source attribution and preliminary-data context.

refreshProposal.proposal: Six-minute product; share one fetch per active prototype, cache and back off. A proposed 30-minute stale threshold is a game policy, not a provider guarantee.

possibleGameUses: Calibrated relative waterline and boat/shore relationships
limitations: Observed height is relative to a tidal datum, not directly game Y=0. Define an authored reference before moving geometry. Do not drive managed Aquarium tank levels from ocean tides.

signals: NOAA sigma and f/q quality flags

sources.name: Monterey tide predictions
signals: future high/low timing from chosen prediction product

spatial.basis: NOAA CO-OPS metadata for station 9413450, checked 2026-10-20. Measurement support is a station, not a bay-wide elevation survey.

access.requirements: No key used. Example returns sampled predictions; request interval=hilo separately if using provider high/low events.
access.rights: Public NOAA service; attribute and label predictions separately from measurements.

refreshProposal.proposal: Cache an appropriate future interval, refresh when coverage or issue time needs it. Suggested six-hour refresh is a prototype choice, not observation cadence.

possibleGameUses: Keep a clearly labeled predicted tide when observations are stale
limitations: Predictions do not include every weather-driven water-level anomaly. A prediction fallback must never be labeled a fresh observation.

mapStudy.product: NOAA predictions; interval=hilo; UTC begin date plus 72 hours; MLLW; metric.
limitations: Provider issue time is not supplied; age is since fetch.
Missing future high/low coverage is stale.

sources.name: Monterey weather forecast

spatial.basis: Existing Aquarium campus anchor used as a query point, not a weather measurement station.

access.requirements: Resolve grid URLs through /points rather than permanently hardcoding MTR/92,51. Follow cache headers and documented application-identification requirements.
access.rights: NWS documentation describes API data as open and free for any purpose; preserve attribution.

refreshProposal.proposal: Conditional/cache-aware fetches on a roughly 15-minute prototype schedule; hourly validity periods are not 15-minute measurements.

possibleGameUses: Wind direction for surface ripples and future kelp/flag motion
Rain/cloud mood using available forecast fields
limitations: Forecast grid support is broader than a precise camera view. Fog requires visibility/ceiling evidence or explicit artistic approximation; a weather icon or humidity alone is insufficient.

signals: wind range metres per second and direction from
limitations: No current valid forecast period is stale.
Browser may strip the application User-Agent override; server integration must set identification reliably.

sources.name: Official local weather/marine alerts

spatial.basis: Existing Aquarium campus anchor used as a query point, not a weather measurement station.

access.requirements: Apply point/zone/geometry and timestamp checks. A local land-point query is not proof that every relevant marine zone is covered.
access.rights: NWS open service; retain issuer, timestamps, attribution and official link.

refreshProposal.proposal: Proposed five-minute conditional refresh; respect cache/rate-limit responses and expiry/cancellation.

possibleGameUses: Optional clearly sourced information at harbor noticeboards
limitations: Keep official alerts distinct from fictional game events. Empty, failed or stale responses do not prove real-world conditions are safe.

sources.name: Offshore Monterey buoy conditions

spatial.basis: Position published by the current station realtime page; historical deployments used different positions.

access.requirements: Probe returned about 612 KB of history and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. Do not poll this full file per player; choose a permitted cached/latest-record delivery path when implementing.
access.rights: Retain NOAA attribution and real-time quality context; inspect selected product metadata.

refreshProposal.proposal: Proposed 20-minute shared refresh; use actual per-variable timestamps. Reporting cadence and missing wave/met fields vary.

possibleGameUses: Regional swell mood and calibrated exposed-water animation
limitations: Offshore buoy is not a dock/harbor measurement. Significant wave height is not a single shader-wave amplitude. Parse MM and missing values as null, not zero; units differ across source columns.

sources.name: Aquarium intake / nearby shore-station water properties

spatial.basis: CeNCOOS names an Aquarium intake station and nearby Monterey Wharf II station. Exact selected station location, variables and dataset are not resolved.

access.requirements: Select a current ERDDAP/THREDDS dataset; check variable units, depth, QA, station coordinates and CORS. No endpoint ID was invented.
access.rights: Dataset-specific attribution and reuse terms must be checked.

refreshProposal.proposal: One-hour initial cache proposal; selected dataset publication interval and sensor availability must govern the final policy.

possibleGameUses: Real-world ecology/conditions cards near the Aquarium
Carefully labeled artistic water-color or seasonal habitat cues
limitations: A coastal intake is not the same as conditions throughout the game area. Chlorophyll is not a direct underwater visibility measurement; water quality does not prove fish presence or catch odds.

sources.name: Regional surface-current grid

spatial.basis: California-coast radar products must be subset to valid cells around the map; no harbor-resolution coverage is assumed.

access.requirements: Choose a current grid/product, subset server-side if permitted, then verify nearshore coverage and CORS.
access.rights: Check chosen dataset license, provider attribution and QA conventions.

refreshProposal.proposal: Hourly products are listed; cache and update on publication rather than at the render rate.

possibleGameUses: Current arrows on the water map
Future slow drift of floating props, with deliberate game scaling
limitations: The listed 500 m product is for San Francisco Bay, not an assumed Monterey service. Grid gaps and kilometre-scale cells cannot resolve small harbors or imply subsurface flow.

sources.name: Recent local wildlife observations

spatial.basis: Use the existing map bounds for public observation queries; respect original uncertainty and obscuration.

access.requirements: Use bounded, cached metadata queries. Check each record/media license and attribution before redistribution.
access.rights: Observation and media rights can differ per record; no blanket reuse assumption.

refreshProposal.proposal: Daily/manual refresh for a rolling recent-observation board; no need for continuous polling.

possibleGameUses: Discovery journal and seasonal habitat information
A source-linked account of what people have reported nearby
limitations: Reports are delayed and sometimes historical uploads, not tracking of live animals. Do not infer precise locations from obscured records or treat a sighting as guaranteed game spawns.

sources.name: Vessel traffic in a bounded bay area
sources.provider: AIS Stream or another licensed AIS provider

spatial.basis: Provider region subscription; transform published WGS84 positions only after validating message age/accuracy.

access.requirements: Provider forbids direct browser connections. Account key belongs on a server; confirm redistribution terms before implementation. No credentials or connection were requested.
access.rights: Provider terms and downstream display rights require review.

refreshProposal.proposal: One bounded server subscription only when the game needs it; reduce to small timestamped client updates and handle gaps/backoff.

possibleGameUses: Optional geographic boat silhouettes or a harbor traffic display
limitations: Not every vessel transmits AIS; coverage, latency and reported positions vary. Do not make missing reports disappear instantly or treat the layer as a complete collision map.

mapStudy.researchFieldsNotice: Original access, refreshProposal, sources and checkedOn fields preserve the October 20 research snapshot. Per-source mapStudy metadata describes the October 22 implementation; researched signals are not all implemented.

browserVerification.scope: Chrome/Vite cross-origin NOAA observed and predicted tides and discovered NWS hourly forecast; one dated successful check, not guaranteed availability.

limitations: No game waterline, lighting or fish behavior changes.
No moon, alerts, buoy, intake, currents, wildlife or AIS integration.
NWS application User-Agent override is best-effort in browsers; a future shared server must reliably send it.
